name: Bestial Spirit
traits: Darkvision 60 ft.

forms.name: Air
traits: Flyby: leaving an enemy's reach while flying does not provoke opportunity attacks.

forms.name: Land
traits: Pack Tactics: advantage when an able ally is within 5 ft of the target.

forms.name: Water
traits: Pack Tactics: advantage when an able ally is within 5 ft of the target.
Breathes only underwater.

name: Fey Spirit

attack.name: Shortsword
attack.note: Each hit also deals 1d6 force damage.

traits: Immune to charm. Darkvision 60 ft.
Fey Step: its own bonus action teleports it up to 30 ft; its mood adds the effect below.

forms.name: Fuming
traits: After Fey Step, its next attack this turn has advantage.

forms.name: Mirthful
traits: After Fey Step, one visible creature within 10 ft makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC or is charmed for up to 1 minute; damage ends the charm.

forms.name: Tricksy
traits: After Fey Step, place magical darkness in a 5-ft cube within 5 ft; it lasts through the spirit's next turn.

name: Shadow Spirit
traits: Resists necrotic damage; immune to fear. Darkvision 120 ft.
Dreadful Scream: once per day, creatures within 30 ft make Wisdom saves against your spell DC or fear the spirit for 1 minute; repeat saves at turn end.

forms.name: Fury
traits: Advantage on attacks against frightened creatures.

forms.name: Despair
traits: Other creatures except you starting within 5 ft lose 20 ft of speed for that turn.

forms.name: Fear
traits: Can Hide as its own bonus action in dim light or darkness.

name: Undead Spirit
traits: Immune to necrotic and poison damage, exhaustion, fear, paralysis and poison. Darkvision 60 ft.

forms.name: Ghostly
traits: Hover. Can cross creatures and objects as difficult terrain; ending inside an object ejects it and deals 1d10 force per 5 ft moved.
A Deathly Touch hit forces a Wisdom save against your spell DC or frightens the target through its next turn.

forms.name: Putrid
traits: Creatures except you starting within 5 ft make a Constitution save against your spell DC or are poisoned until their next turn.
A claw hit on a poisoned target forces a Constitution save against your spell DC or paralysis through its next turn.

name: Aberrant Spirit
traits: Immune to psychic damage. Darkvision 60 ft.

forms.name: Beholderkin
traits: Hover.

forms.name: Slaad

attack.name: Claws
attack.note: A creature hit cannot regain HP before the spirit's next turn.

traits: At turn start, regains 5 HP if still above 0 HP; record healing manually.

forms.name: Star Spawn
traits: While able to act, at turn start creatures within 5 ft make Wisdom saves against your spell DC or take 2d6 psychic damage.

name: Construct Spirit
traits: Resists poison damage. Immune to charm, exhaustion, fear, incapacitation, paralysis, petrification and poison. Darkvision 60 ft.

forms.name: Clay
traits: Reaction when damaged: slam a random creature within 5 ft, or move half speed toward a visible enemy without opportunity attacks. DM chooses the random target.

forms.name: Metal
traits: A creature touching it or hitting it with a melee attack from within 5 ft takes 1d10 fire damage.

forms.name: Stone
traits: When a visible creature starts within 10 ft: Wisdom save against your spell DC or no reactions and half speed for that turn.

name: Elemental Spirit
traits: Immune to poison damage, exhaustion, fear, paralysis, petrification, poison and unconsciousness. Darkvision 60 ft.

forms.name: Air
traits: Hover; resists lightning and thunder. Can pass through 1-inch gaps.

forms.name: Earth
traits: Resists piercing and slashing damage.

forms.name: Fire
traits: Immune to fire damage. Can pass through 1-inch gaps.

forms.name: Water
traits: Resists acid damage. Can pass through 1-inch gaps.

name: Celestial Spirit

attack.name: Radiant Mace
attack.note: On a hit, itself or a visible creature within 10 ft of the target can gain 1d10 temporary HP; record manually.

traits: Resists radiant damage; immune to charm and fear. Darkvision 60 ft.
Healing Touch: once per day, another creature regains 2d8 + spell level HP; record the result manually.

name: Draconic Spirit
traits: Immune to charm, fear and poison. Blindsight 30 ft; darkvision 60 ft.
Choose one of its resistances to share while the spell lasts; record the owner's resistance manually.
Its Attack action also includes a 30-ft cone breath: Dexterity save against your spell DC, 2d6 of a damage type it resists, half on success.

forms.name: Chromatic
traits: Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison.

forms.name: Gem
traits: Resists force, necrotic, psychic, radiant and thunder.

forms.name: Metallic
traits: Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison.

name: Fiendish Spirit
traits: Resists fire; immune to poison damage and poison. Darkvision 60 ft.
Magic Resistance: advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.

forms.name: Demon
traits: At 0 HP or spell end, explodes within 10 ft: Dexterity save against your spell DC, 2d10 + spell level fire, half on success; record outcomes manually.

forms.name: Devil

attack.name: Hurl Flame
attack.note: Unattended flammable objects hit catch fire.

traits: Sees through magical darkness.

attack.name: Claws
attack.note: After attacking, can teleport up to 30 ft to a visible empty space.
